about:
McCann Woodworking operates from a historic carriage house in downtown Morristown, New Jersey. Founded in 2010 by Mickey McCann, the business began as a small wood shop after McCann completed training at The Krenov School in Northern California, formerly the College of the Redwoods Fine Woodworking Program. The company is organized as a limited liability company.

The shop specializes in furniture making and antique restoration, emphasizing fine hand skills and a careful eye for harmony in design. McCann works as both designer and maker, producing custom furniture pieces and restoring antique items. The operation remains a small-scale workshop without published metrics on facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

McCann Woodworking serves clients seeking custom furniture and antique restoration services. The company does not publicly list specific industry sectors or customer types beyond its core offerings in fine woodworking.

McCann’s background at The Krenov School informs the shop’s approach, focusing on hand-tool techniques and design integrity. The company highlights this training and its emphasis on craftsmanship as central to its work.
